entities.summary: Douglas Kent Hall was an American writer and photographer. His writing mostly focused on fiction, poetry, non-fiction, essays, and screenplays. His first published photographs were of Jimi Hendrix and Jim Morrison, and in 1974 his first exhibition was at the Whitney Museum of American Art in New York.
